title: Briefing for 2026-11-28
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-28: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: China’s factories are growing profits again, but the AI boom is picking the winners. Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos set to lead European Central Bank. U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals. Liesman: Why Greenspan could bet on productivity — and Warsh needs to hike. Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, raising the 2027 stakes for the central bank. Even the price of toys is on the rise. How Americans are scaling back holiday plans.
global: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes. Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview. Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter. Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'. 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims. Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza.
philippines: More than a place to eat: Inside Cavite’s thriving food bazaar culture. LIVE UPDATES: Rodrigo Duterte on trial at the ICC. [Vantage Point] The Legarda-Leviste solar empire: From government contracts to private billions. Saving reefs: Coral Triangle expedition makes its way to the Philippines.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
